mapper.select: select g.`id`, g.`name`, g.`type`, g.`ranges`, g.`classes_type`, g.`auto_rest`, g.`is_punch_card`, g.`is_supplement_card`, g.`is_work_overtime`, g.`punch_card_way_str`, g.`tenant` from `attendance_group` g left join `attendance_group_staff` s on g.`id` = s.`group_id` where s.`staff_id` = #{userId} and g.`type` = 'ARRANGE' limit 1
